claims: The lowest 72-hole score in Masters history is 268.
Dustin Johnson achieved a 72-hole score of 268 at 20-under-par in the 2020 Masters.
The 2020 Masters was played in November due to COVID-19.
Dustin Johnson's 2020 Masters performance broke the previous record by two strokes.
The lowest total score to par at The Masters is -20 by Dustin Johnson in 2020.
The lowest single round at The Masters is 63 by Nick Price in 1986.
The lowest single round at The Masters is 63 by Greg Norman in 1996.
The lowest 54-hole score at The Masters is 200 by Jordan Spieth in 2015.
The lowest 54-hole score at The Masters is 200 by Dustin Johnson in 2020.
The widest margin of victory at The Masters is 12 strokes by Tiger Woods in 1997.
Dustin Johnson finished the 2020 Masters with rounds of 65, 70, 65, and 68.
The previous record of 270 (-18) at The Masters was jointly held by Tiger Woods in 1997 and Jordan Spieth in 2015.
Dustin Johnson's 2020 Masters score occurred on a softer, autumn-conditioned Augusta National without patrons.
The 2020 Masters conditions were noted as different from the traditional April tournament.
